en-US.longDescription: MOOS Project Viewer is a viewer for Microsoft® Project that allows you to open, view in a dynamic way and print any Microsoft® Project file. It is running on any Java enabled platform including Windows®, Mac OS X and Linux. There are many viewers for Microsoft® Project on the market, some freeware and others commercial. MOOS Project Viewer is the best choice in terms of features per price. But don't just take our word for it. Try it yourself!
en-US.name: MOOS Project Viewer

zh-CN.longDescription: MOOS Project Viewer 是一款专为 Microsoft® Project 设计的查看器，支持动态打开、浏览及打印任何 Microsoft® Project 文件。它能在所有支持 Java 的平台上运行，包括 Windows®、Mac OS X 和 Linux 系统。市面上虽有众多 Microsoft® Project 查看器（含免费版和商业版），但 MOOS Project Viewer 以卓越的性价比脱颖而出。无需轻信我们的宣传，亲自试用便知分晓！
